facts: The saved reply for delayed orders lists support hours of 9:00 to 17:00 (the ticket's body).
Since 2026-10-01, support answers from 8:00 to 20:00 (the ticket's body).
The hours are the same on weekends (the comment of 2026-10-17) and on public holidays (the answer to the question about public holidays).
The instruction keeps the change to the delayed-order reply.
A change written on the proposal on 2026-10-17 asks that the reply say that the hours apply every day.
solution: In the saved reply for delayed orders, replace 9:00 to 17:00 with 8:00 to 20:00. Add that these hours apply every day, on weekends and public holidays too. Keep the rest of the reply's text as it is, and leave the other saved replies unchanged.
